discription: A short, percussive pluck sound using an impulse and a resonant filter for a synthetic string-like effect.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, decay=0.2, rq=0.9; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.perc(0.001, decay, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Impulse.ar(0); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
